hook: The skin you touch is made of cells that finished their lives: new cells are born deep down, rise, flatten, lose their nuclei, seal water in as bricks, and drift away over about a month.

chatgptPrompt:
Create a 9:16 (1080x1920) Short cover, focal point inside the centre safe area (clear of the bottom 25% and the right edge).
Subject: a soft 3-D voxel cut-away of skin as rows of rounded, touching rosy-orange cells (medium skin tone) each with a small soft dusky-lilac nucleus glowing inside, standing on the pink rounded voxels of the dermis with a soft vessel in it. No face, no person.
Composition: the cells fill the frame above the dermis, the text over the upper third.
Lighting and treatment: soft studio light, a warm glow where the skin meets the dark, very dark green-black ground (#0B1513), shallow depth of field, fine film grain.
Mood: quiet, calm, ASMR.
Text: "From the bottom up" in a small ivory (#F4EDE3) editorial serif, upper centre.
Scientific accuracy: skin cells are made at the bottom of the epidermis, rise, flatten and lose their nuclei, and the dead outer cells are shed; an illustration, not to scale, not a photograph.
Avoid: no faces, arrows, circles, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real medical photo.
Style: premium medical-editorial documentary illustration, soft voxel (rounded cube) look, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
